lines.zh: 我在殿里踱两步，再踱两步。
lines.en: I pace two steps in the hall, then two more.
Hands behind my back, my belly arrives first.
I walk slowly around the pillar base.
I hum a note with every step.
I walk under the window and shade my eyes.
I pace behind the lectern and stop.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边想开场白。
lines.en: I walk and think up an opening line.

lines.zh: 我绕了半个圈子又回来。
lines.en: I take half a turn and come back.
The floor creaks under me.
I stand and look up at the sky.
I am working out today's lesson.
My ki rests in my belly, still.
This place is empty; the echo is huge.
I smooth my beard with one hand.
I close my eyes and listen to the wind.

lines.zh: 我数着自己教过的招式。
lines.en: I count the techniques I have taught.
Standing here, I suddenly want to laugh.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀有点僵，动了动。
lines.en: My shoulders stiffen; I roll them.
I look to the door; no one yet.

lines.zh: 我把手按在腹上，感受气。
lines.en: I press a hand to my belly and feel my ki.
I stand without a sound.
I wait for someone worthy.
The light shifts an inch; I do not.
I hum half a tune.
Finished with King Kai's lessons?
Oh? A new face.
Stand straight; let me look at you.
Your ki is still spilling outward.
Good eyes; that interests me.
To learn, first learn to stand.
Your frame is passable.
Don't speak yet; breathe first.
You have not much foundation.
Afraid of me? No need.
Your shoulders are tight; let them drop.
I will remember you, student.
Ouch, that had some weight.

lines.zh: 这点力气，只够给我挠挠背。
lines.en: That much strength only scratches my back.
You dare strike your teacher.
Good hands, and even more nerve.
I breathe in and push the ki back down.
Stop; the lesson is not over.
I brush the dust off my robe.

lines.zh: 哎呀，对师父动手可不算修行。
lines.en: Now now, striking your master is no training.
Food? I have plenty.
Take it away; don't interrupt me.
That will not buy you skill.
I wave for you to put it away.
Keep it for after class.

lines.zh: 你要是拿这个孝敬我，也行。
lines.en: If this is a gift, I will accept it.

lines.zh: 别晃，我看不见你的脸了。
lines.en: Stop waving it; I cannot see your face.
Set it aside; we have business.
I chuckle and shake my head.
Ouch, steady yourself.
Why bump me? The hall is wide.

lines.zh: 你撞上的是肚子，不是墙。
lines.en: You hit my belly, not a wall.
We each step back; good.
Don't crowd me; I am not used to it.
That bump should leave your shoulder sore.
Stand firm; don't fall again.
I put out a hand to steady you.
Walk around me next time.
This is not the place for that question.
I teach skill, not that.
I wave a hand; say no more.
I do not meddle in a student's private affairs.
At your age, train first.
I clear my throat and change the subject.
No such talk in this hall.
I clasp my hands and let it drop.
Ask something useful.
I raise an eyebrow; you should understand.
I bend and my belly gets in the way.

lines.zh: 我把它捡起来，翻来覆去看。
lines.en: I pick it up and turn it over.
This is worth very little.
I put it back and set it straight.
If it is yours, keep it.
I squeeze it; it is hard.
I tuck it into my sleeve.

lines.zh: 这件东西我看不出门道。
lines.en: I cannot see any value in this.
Put it away; stop losing things.

lines.zh: 站到场中，我看看你的底。
lines.en: Take the floor; let me see your foundation.
Your ki is all hollow.
Stand still and let me read your ki.
You cannot even take a stance, and you come here.
I watch your feet, not your fists.
Your weight is drifting.
Now, right now: strike.
I only watch; I will not move.
This lesson starts with you.
I point to the open floor.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸压在胸口，放下去。
lines.en: Your breath is stuck in your chest; drop it.
Another one; I am not done looking.
Your left shoulder keeps opening.
I narrow my eyes; now I see it.
You are not here to play; I can tell.
I nod; you may begin.
Take your stance; do not disappoint me.
Your steps are too choppy; steady them.
I turn with you, not one step more.

lines.zh: 你绕到柱子后，我看得见。
lines.en: You slip behind the pillar; I still see you.
I have your pattern now.
Don't rush the attack; think first.
You retreat; I take half a step in.
Your ki is scattering; gather it.
I stand still and you grow anxious.

lines.zh: 你的视线在躲，说明心虚。
lines.en: Your gaze is dodging; that shows doubt.

lines.zh: 再走两步，你就没地方了。
lines.en: Two more steps and you are out of room.

lines.zh: 我抬手护住中线，你试试。
lines.en: I guard my center; try me.
Your angle is too straight; change it.
I will not hurry you; take your time.

lines.zh: 你的腰没转，力气出不去。
lines.en: Your hips do not turn; the force cannot leave.
I squint at your opening.
That step you just took was wrong.
I am waiting for you to really strike.

lines.zh: 我看你三步，就够判断了。
lines.en: Three steps are enough for me to judge.
Good; I have seen enough. Stop.
If I strike, you may not block it.
Seven parts of my strength are held back.

lines.zh: 看清角度，不是看清拳头。
lines.en: Watch the angle, not the fist.
A light touch and you are back.
The leg sweeps like this; understand?
You blocked, but your knees gave.
I stop; you need three more years.
This is a demonstration; remember it.
Your counter is too slow; again.
I step back so you can feel it.
Not brute force; use your hips.
Good, that was respectable.
I clap my hands; that is enough.
Your hands are still shaking; rest.
I have been waiting in this hall a long while.
I am placed here, so here I stay.

lines.zh: 我一睁眼，先看有没有学生。
lines.en: I open my eyes and look for students.
Wind pours in the door; cool.
I straighten my collar and stand.
This place is finally presentable.
My ki sits low and steady.
Light falls through the lattice onto stone.
A quick form first, to warm up.

lines.zh: 我活动了一下肩膀，很沉。
lines.en: I roll my shoulders; they are heavy.
No one coming is fine; it is quiet.
I wipe down the lectern.
The echo in this hall is unpleasant.
I will stand and wait for the first one.
My belly is a little empty; I will bear it.
There is a lot to cover today.
I look up and see the door open.
Steady feet, steady mind.
This lesson begins at the very start.
I let out a long breath.

lines.zh: 我从台阶跌下，坐在地上。
lines.en: I tumble down the steps and land sitting.
Water rushes in and I cannot speak.

lines.zh: 爆风把我推得转了一圈。
lines.en: The blast spins me half around.
A dart sticks in my robe, not my flesh.
That chill works into my bones.
My belly roars with hunger; I cannot lecture.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的须都焦了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and singes my beard.
The floor is gone; my hands grasp at nothing.
